entities.summary: Yulia Sirko is a Ukrainian politician, Member of Verkhovna Rada since 2019, vice-chair of the parliamentary Infrastructure and Transport Committee, Deputy head of Golos party faction, Secretary of the Ukrainian-Indian friendship group and Co-chair of the parliamentary maritime group.
